description: Presidential Secretariat - Order by His Excellency the President, to call out all the Members of Armed Forces for Maintenance of public order with effect from December 22, 2020
categorisation: This gazette content involves the invocation of legal powers under the Public Security Ordinance (a specific law) to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. It constitutes a legal/regulatory action by the President exercising statutory authority, making it primarily about legal framework and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes or organizational structure.
